result:
**Shape:** short-lived access token plus rotating, device-bound refresh token, backed by a server-side session row per device.

## Sign-in
- OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code + PKCE through system browser (`ASWebAuthenticationSession`, Android Custom Tabs). No embedded WebView.
- Passkeys primary. Password + TOTP fallback, with one-time recovery codes.
- On first sign-in, app generates a keypair in Secure Enclave / StrongBox and registers the public key with the session.
- Server creates session row: `session_id, user_id, device_name, public_key, refresh_hash, family_id, created_at, last_used_at, expires_at, revoked_at`.
- Email user on every new-device sign-in.

## Tokens
- **Access:** JWT, ES256, 10 min, carries `sub`, `sid`, `aud`, `exp`. API validates it locally.
- **Refresh:** opaque 256-bit random, stored only as hash. 30 day idle expiry, 90 day absolute.
- Store both in Keychain (`kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly`) or Keystore-backed encrypted storage. Never plain `SharedPreferences` or `AsyncStorage`.

## Refresh
- `POST /auth/refresh` with refresh token plus DPoP proof signed by the device key. Stolen token without the key is useless.
- Rotate on every use: issue new refresh token, invalidate old one.
- Reuse of an old token revokes the whole family and forces sign-in.
- Allow 10 s grace where the previous token returns the same new pair. Otherwise flaky networks trigger false reuse alarms.
- Client: single-flight refresh. On 401, refresh once, retry once, else go to sign-in.

## Logout
- `POST /auth/logout`: set `revoked_at` on session, unregister push token, wipe local tokens and cached user data.
- Access token stays valid up to 10 min. For instant kill, cache revoked `sid` values (TTL 10 min) and check them on every request, or on sensitive endpoints only.

## Lost phone
- Account settings (web or another device) lists sessions with device name and last-used time. User can revoke one or all.
- Password change or passkey removal revokes all sessions.
- Revocation takes effect at next refresh, 10 min worst case, or instantly with the `sid` deny-list.
- Thief with an unlocked phone: gate app open behind biometric or device PIN, and require fresh re-auth for sensitive actions (change email, add passkey, payments).
- Recovery on new phone: synced passkey or password plus recovery code. TOTP seed on the lost phone is gone, so recovery codes are mandatory at MFA enrolment.
